slides.headline: Chemical equation balance
slides.sub: Same atoms on both sides; use coefficients, NOT subscripts

slides.headline: Types of reactions
slides.sub: Combustion (O₂), decomposition, combination, displacement, redox

slides.headline: Exothermic reaction
slides.sub: Releases heat/energy to surroundings (ΔH < 0)

slides.headline: Endothermic reaction
slides.sub: Absorbs heat/energy from surroundings (ΔH > 0)

slides.headline: Redox definition
slides.sub: Oxidation = loss of e⁻; reduction = gain of e⁻

slides.headline: Oxidation state rules
slides.sub: Element = 0; monoatomic ion = charge; O usually -2; H usually +1

subject: Chemistry
cover: Acids, Bases, Salts — Class 10 CBSE (save this)

slides.headline: Acid definition (Arrhenius)
slides.sub: Substance producing H⁺ in aqueous solution

slides.headline: Base definition (Arrhenius)
slides.sub: Substance producing OH⁻ in aqueous solution

slides.headline: pH scale
slides.sub: pH = -log[H⁺]; acidic < 7 < basic; neutral = 7

slides.headline: Strong vs weak acids
slides.sub: Strong: HCl, HNO₃, H₂SO₄ (complete ionization); weak: acetic, carbonic

slides.headline: Neutralization reaction
slides.sub: Acid + Base → Salt + Water

slides.headline: Salt definition
slides.sub: Ionic compound from acid + base; neutral if from strong acid/base

slides.headline: Indicators
slides.sub: Litmus, phenolphthalein, methyl orange change color in acid/base

slides.headline: Metal properties
slides.sub: Lustrous, malleable, ductile, conduct heat/electricity, lose e⁻ easily

slides.headline: Non-metal properties
slides.sub: Non-lustrous, brittle, non-ductile, poor conductors (except graphite)

slides.headline: Metal reactivity series
slides.sub: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > C > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Hg > Ag > Au

slides.headline: Corrosion definition
slides.sub: Surface oxidation of metal; rusting of iron = Fe₂O₃·xH₂O

slides.headline: Metal + oxygen reaction
slides.sub: 2M + O₂ → 2MO (or M₂O₃, MO₂ depending on metal)

slides.headline: Displacement reaction
slides.sub: More reactive metal displaces less reactive: A + BC → AC + B

slides.headline: Covalent bonding in carbon
slides.sub: 4 valence e⁻; forms 4 covalent bonds; strong C-C chains

slides.headline: Saturated hydrocarbon (alkane)
slides.sub: C_nH_{2n+2}; single C-C bonds; CnH2n+2

slides.headline: Unsaturated hydrocarbon (alkene)
slides.sub: C_nH_{2n}; C=C double bond

slides.headline: Alkyne formula
slides.sub: C_nH_{2n-2}; C≡C triple bond

slides.headline: Functional groups
slides.sub: -OH (alcohol), -COOH (carboxylic acid), -CHO (aldehyde)

slides.headline: Combustion of hydrocarbons
slides.sub: CₙH₂ₘ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O (balance by atoms)

slides.headline: Esterification
slides.sub: Alcohol + carboxylic acid → ester + water (reversible, acid-catalyzed)

slides.headline: Photosynthesis equation
slides.sub: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂

slides.headline: Photosynthesis location
slides.sub: Light reaction in thylakoid; dark reaction (Calvin cycle) in stroma

slides.headline: Respiration (aerobic)
slides.sub: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + energy (ATP)

slides.headline: Respiration location
slides.sub: Glycolysis (cytoplasm); Krebs cycle + ETC (mitochondrial matrix/cristae)

slides.headline: Anaerobic respiration (fermentation)
slides.sub: Glucose → lactate (animals) or ethanol (plants) without O₂

slides.headline: Digestion: carbohydrate
slides.sub: Mouth (amylase) → stomach → small intestine; glucose absorbed

slides.headline: Excretion: kidney structure
slides.sub: Glomerulus → Bowman → proximal tubule → loop of Henle → collecting duct

subject: Physics
cover: Optics: Reflection & Refraction — Class 10 CBSE (save this)

slides.headline: Law of reflection
slides.sub: Angle of incidence = angle of reflection (∠i = ∠r)

slides.headline: Mirror formula
slides.sub: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u; f = R/2 (R = radius of curvature)

slides.headline: Magnification (mirror)
slides.sub: m = h'/h = -v/u (- means inverted)

slides.headline: Snell's law
slides.sub: n₁sin(θ₁) = n₂sin(θ₂); n = c/v

slides.headline: Lens formula
slides.sub: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u (same as mirror)

slides.headline: Lens power
slides.sub: P = 1/f (diopters, D); convex +, concave -

slides.headline: Critical angle & TIR
slides.sub: sin(θc) = n₂/n₁; total internal reflection if θ > θc

slides.headline: Eye structure
slides.sub: Cornea (refraction) → lens (accommodation) → retina (image) → optic nerve

slides.headline: Accommodation
slides.sub: Ciliary muscles change lens shape; near point ≈ 25 cm, far point ≈ ∞

slides.headline: Myopia (short-sight)
slides.sub: Image forms before retina; far point < ∞; corrected by concave lens

slides.headline: Hyperopia (far-sight)
slides.sub: Image forms behind retina; near point > 25 cm; corrected by convex lens

slides.headline: Presbyopia
slides.sub: Age-related; lens loses flexibility; corrected by bifocal lens

slides.headline: Dispersion of light
slides.sub: White light splits into spectrum (VIBGYOR) by different refractive indices

slides.headline: Electric current definition
slides.sub: I = Q/t; unit = Ampere (A); flow of charge per unit time

slides.headline: Ohm's law
slides.sub: V = IR; resistance R = V/I; unit = Ohm (Ω)

slides.headline: Resistivity
slides.sub: R = ρL/A; ρ = resistivity, L = length, A = cross-section area

slides.headline: Series resistance
slides.sub: R_total = R₁ + R₂ + ... (same current, V divides)

slides.headline: Parallel resistance
slides.sub: 1/R_total = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + ... (same V, I divides)

slides.headline: Power of electric current
slides.sub: P = VI = I²R = V²/R; unit = Watt (W)

slides.headline: Joule's heating law
slides.sub: H = I²Rt; heat produced in resistor

slides.headline: Magnetic field around conductor
slides.sub: Right-hand thumb rule: thumb along I, fingers curl along field

slides.headline: Force on current-carrying wire
slides.sub: F = BIL; B = magnetic field, I = current, L = length

slides.headline: Fleming's left-hand rule
slides.sub: Thumb = force, Forefinger = field, Middle = current

slides.headline: Electromagnetic induction
slides.sub: Changing magnetic flux induces EMF: ε = -dΦ/dt

slides.headline: Lenz's law
slides.sub: Induced current opposes change in magnetic flux

slides.headline: AC generator principle
slides.sub: Rotating coil in B-field; EMF = ε₀sin(ωt); ε₀ = NABω

slides.headline: Direct current (DC) vs AC
slides.sub: DC: constant; AC: sinusoidal; household India = 50 Hz
